summary: E2E UI validation (mobile 390x844, preview) of the OFF360 catálogo/entrega/1ª-compra/pedir-entregador pacote against the pre-validated backend (22/22). Seeded QAFULL_1786766441 accounts via API and exercised UI end-to-end. Result: ALL 8 requested scenarios PASS after fixing ONE CRITICAL missing-import bug in EstablishmentDetail.js (ReferenceError 'Input is not defined' inside DeliveryPanel — completely blocked the consumer vitrine/order flow until fixed). After the fix, the full happy path works: merchant catalog CRUD + config persist, consumer vitrine renders both cards with the MAX-discount rule applied (Combo 10 (10%) → shows 30% OFF via 1ª compra R$35,00; Combo 40 (40%) → shows 40% OFF via product R$60,00), subtotal R$95, taxa R$7, total R$102, ETA 40 min, order created, first-purchase-badge visible; merchant panel shows m-request-deliverer-box, taxa R$12, escopo Independentes → request → toast 'Entregador solicitado! Oferta enviada.'; independent deliverer sees d-ride-fee 'Você recebe pela entrega: R$ 12,00' BEFORE accept, d-customer-address + d-customer-maps present; after ACEITAR, d-start button shows 'Iniciar entrega · você recebe R$ 12,00' and clicking it goes DIRECT (no d-start-dialog) to 'Em andamento'; d-status-dot piscante rendered; d-arrive → wrong code 0000 rejected ('Código inválido ou já utilizado'); correct 4-digit validation_code (5739) → 'Entrega concluída!' with Seu ganho R$ 12,00 in Histórico. No breakage of previously approved flows.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED by testing agent: file imported Button but not Input from @/components/ui/input, while DeliveryPanel used <Input> for addr-street/addr-number/addr-neighborhood/addr-city/addr-complement. This threw 'ReferenceError: Input is not defined' the moment the establishment page was opened as consumer, showing the CRA red overlay and blocking the ENTIRE consumer vitrine + delivery + order-create flow. Patch: added `import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';` (line 8). Verified: consumer-catalog + consumer-address + order-summary + order-create all work after fix.

action_items: Review the one-line import fix in /app/frontend/src/pages/consumer/EstablishmentDetail.js (added `import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';`). Consider adding an ESLint rule / build-time check for undefined React components to catch this class of bug before ship — it is a repeat pattern (previous iteration_31 had a similar oversight in Orders.js).

Optional UX nit: when merchant clicks 🛵 SOLICITAR ENTREGADOR on a 'new' order, backend automatically transitions status to 'ready' and the m-request-deliverer-box disappears — the merchant may still be preparing the food. Confirm this auto-transition is intentional; if not, consider keeping the order in its current status and just flipping ride_requested.
critical_code_review_comments: EstablishmentDetail.js: the missing Input import is a repeat oversight; consider a shared shadcn import barrel or an ESLint no-undef rule for JSX identifiers.

The MAX-discount rule is implemented correctly in the UI (verified visually — 10%-product with 30% first-purchase renders as 30% OFF; 40%-product with 30% first-purchase renders as 40% OFF, never summed).

Deliverer.js already handles the two paths cleanly: `if (o.deliverer_earning != null) doStartDirect(o); else setStartOrder(o);` — the ganho dialog no longer appears when merchant pre-set the ride fee, matching the spec.
consumer/EstablishmentDetail.js DeliveryPanel — sum-fee is only rendered on delivery mode, sum-eta only when avg_prep_minutes>0. Good conditional rendering.
Backend allows negative or missing avg_prep_minutes (parseInt(form.avg_prep_minutes, 10)) — minor: could reject <=0 explicitly.

rca of the issue: RCA: /app/frontend/src/pages/consumer/EstablishmentDetail.js was extended with a DeliveryPanel that uses <Input> for the consumer address (addr-street/addr-number/…) but the file only imported { Button } from '@/components/ui/button' — never Input. React therefore threw `ReferenceError: Input is not defined` while rendering DeliveryPanel, which caused the CRA runtime overlay to cover the entire consumer establishment page. Reproduction: log in as any consumer → open /establishment/<any active id with offers_delivery=true> → red overlay before any interaction. Mitigation applied: added `import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';` on line 8 of EstablishmentDetail.js. Verified end-to-end (2 catalog cards, MAX-discount rule, delivery mode, address form, summary, order create, request-deliverer, deliverer accept, code validate).
